Ok, so the hospital that I work at is converting the parking garage into a 1,500 patient care area. The plumbers are building elevated platforms with toilets and sinks, and we are utilizing a couple of storm drain interceptors for sanitary sewer holding tanks. They are even installing two water heaters on each floor. also they are framing the outside with wood and using plastic fireproof sheeting for walls.
